SendAction.description: Sends a /me line in your Twitch chat, shown in italics. If that is not possible, it is sent as a normal chat message. Empty text sends nothing.

TriggerEvent.description: Fires a custom event by name. Actions with a "Custom code event" trigger for that name run, and get this action's variables unless you pass false.

KeyboardPress.description: Presses keys on your keyboard for you, like {F13} or ^{S} for Ctrl+S (+ is Shift, % is Alt). Fails with "not supported" when Cuebot cannot press keys on this computer.

ExecuteMethod.description: Runs one method (with no inputs) from another "Execute C# code" sub-action. It finds that code by its "Code name" setting, or as the first C# code in the action with that name.
ExecuteMethod.returns: What the method gives back (true for methods that give nothing). false when the code or method is not found.

TriggerCodeEvent.description: Fires a custom event by name, with the values of a JSON text (like {"amount": 50}) as its variables. Actions with a "Custom code event" trigger for that name run.

UrlEncode.description: Makes text safe to put in a web link, for example spaces become %20.
UrlEncode.example:
string safe = CPH.UrlEncode("hello world & friends");
CPH.LogInfo(safe);

EscapeString.description: Makes text safe to put inside a JSON text value: quotes, backslashes and line breaks get a backslash in front.

BroadcastUdp.description: Sends a small message (UDP) to a port on this computer only (127.0.0.1). Text is sent as is; anything else is sent as JSON.

AddUserToGroup.description: Older form: adds a Twitch user to one of your groups by their number id. The group must already exist.
AddUserToGroup.returns: true when they were added. false when they were already in it or the group does not exist.

RemoveUserFromGroup.description: Older form: takes a Twitch user out of one of your groups by their number id.
RemoveUserFromGroup.returns: true when they were removed. false when they were not in it.

UserInGroup.description: Older form: checks whether a Twitch user (by their number id) is in one of your groups.
UserInGroup.returns: true when they are in the group, otherwise false.

DiscordPostTextToWebhook.description: Older form: posts a message to a Discord channel through its webhook link, with an optional bot name and read-aloud (TTS) switch, but no picture.
DiscordPostTextToWebhook.returns: The new Discord message's id, or empty text when Discord did not say.
DiscordPostTextToWebhook.example:
string id = CPH.DiscordPostTextToWebhook("https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123/abc", "We are live!", "Cuebot", false);
CPH.LogInfo($"Message id: {id}");

WebsocketSend.description: Sends bytes through one of your WebSocket clients (set up on the Servers page). Cuebot turns the bytes into text first. 0 is your first client.
